chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Qasim ibn Yahya, from his grandfather al-Hasan ibn Rashid, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of God (may God's blessings be upon him and his family) said: 'Have many children; through you I shall outstrip the other nations in number on the morrow (the Day of Judgment).'

key_terms.أَكْثِرُوا الْوَلَدَ: Have many children — a prophetic encouragement to increase offspring
key_terms.أُكَاثِرْ: I shall outstrip in number — the Prophet's expression of pride in his community's size
key_terms.الْأُمَمَ: The nations/communities — referring to all religious communities on the Day of Judgment
key_terms.غَداً: Tomorrow — a Quranic/prophetic idiom referring to the Day of Resurrection

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about having children in Al-Kafi?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad encourages his followers to have many children, expressing that his community's large population will be a source of pride and distinction on the Day of Judgment. The phrase 'tomorrow' (ghadan) in classical Islamic usage refers to the Day of Resurrection, a common literary device in prophetic speech. This hadith was transmitted through Imam al-Sadiq and reflects a broader tradition encouraging the growth of the Muslim community.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Qasim Bin Yahya, from his grandather Al Hassan Bin Rashid, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Have more children, by you (having more children) I<sup>saww</sup> (would have) the most populous community tomorrow’.
en.sarwar: 3. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Qasim ibn Yahya from his grandfather al-Hassan ibn Rashid from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, ‘You (my followers) should bring up more children because I will claim to have the majority with you among the nations tomorrow (on the Day of Judgment).”’
